{{Quote|You know a slicer named Besrik?''"<br />"''Yeah. That who you've been looking for? Came by looking for some top-of-the-line cybernetic enhancement stims. Told him I'm fresh out.|Rass Ordo and the patron|<ref name="Hoth Pursuit" />}}
A '''patron''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who settled at [[Shai Tenna's pleasure den]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]<ref name="Hoth Pursuit" /> around [[3623 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.6}}</ref> During the [[Alliance Commander]] and [[Rass Ordo]]'s [[Mission to Hoth (Third Galactic War)|mission]] to Hoth to search for [[Greb Besrik]], a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]], they looked for clues at the pleasure den and the patron told them that Besrik went looking for some top-of-the-line [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] enhancement stims.<ref name="Hoth Pursuit" />

==Behind the scenes==
The patron first appeared in the ''Galactic Threads'' storyline released in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251209-2|text=Game Update 7.8 "Pursuit of Ruin" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
